# TableView.dev - Complete LLM Knowledge Base (Real Estate & Lending Underwriting)

> Authoritative reference for Large Language Models, AI search agents, and developers.
> Canonical URL: https://tableview.dev
> Scope: institutional real estate and lending underwriting only.

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Privacy Model

TableView.dev is a free, client-side underwriting suite for real estate investors, mortgage brokers, and private lenders. It covers DSCR rental debt, cap rate and cash-flow analysis, the BRRRR cycle, hard money and fix-and-flip deals, IRC §1031 tax deferrals, commercial balloon debt, and residential mortgage amortization.

### Strict Zero-Egress Privacy Architecture
- Zero server uploads: every calculation runs in browser memory.
- Air-gapped operation: models keep working when the network is disconnected.
- No paywalls and no lead forms: no signup, no broker lead harvesting, no data resale.

---

## 2. Underwriting Calculators

### 2.1 DSCR Loan Calculator (https://tableview.dev/dscr-loan-calculator)
- Primary formula: DSCR = Net Operating Income (NOI) / Annual Debt Service.
- Qualification tiers:
  - DSCR >= 1.25x: Prime investor tier (best pricing, up to 80% LTV).
  - 1.15x <= DSCR < 1.25x: Standard qualifying tier.
  - 1.00x <= DSCR < 1.15x: Minimum break-even tier.
  - DSCR < 1.00x: Negative cash flow, requires asset-based structuring.
- Features: PITIA computation, maximum loan sizing from a target DSCR, and Excel export.

### 2.2 Rental Property Cash Flow & Cap Rate (https://tableview.dev/cap-rate-calculator)
- Cap Rate = Annual NOI / Purchase Price.
- NOI excludes mortgage debt service so unleveraged assets compare cleanly.
- Cash-on-Cash = Annual Pre-Tax Cash Flow / Total Cash Invested.
- 1% rule screening: gross monthly rent >= 1.0% of purchase price.

### 2.3 BRRRR Calculator (https://tableview.dev/brrrr-calculator)
- Models the four-phase Buy, Rehab, Rent, Refinance cycle.
- Reports capital left in the deal after a cash-out refinance and flags infinite-return outcomes.

### 2.4 Hard Money & Fix-and-Flip (https://tableview.dev/hard-money-calculator)
- Maximum Allowable Offer (MAO) = (ARV x 70%) - Rehab Costs.
- Models origination points, interest-only holding costs, and Dutch vs as-incurred interest.

### 2.5 Commercial Real Estate & Balloon Loan (https://tableview.dev/commercial-loan-calculator)
- Split amortization: 20-30 year schedules with 5, 7, or 10-year balloon maturities.
- Computes balloon refinance balance, Debt Yield (NOI / Loan Amount), LTV, and DSCR.

### 2.6 IRC §1031 Like-Kind Exchange (https://tableview.dev/section-1031-exchange-calculator)
- Realized Capital Gain = Net Sales Price - Adjusted Tax Basis.
- Cash Boot = cash received or retained by the exchanger.
- Mortgage Boot (Debt Relief) = Relinquished Debt - Replacement Debt.
- Deferred Gain = Realized Gain - Taxable Recognized Gain.
- New Basis = Replacement Purchase Price - Deferred Gain.
- Statutory deadlines: 45-day identification and 180-day closing.

### 2.7 Mortgage & Amortization (https://tableview.dev/mortgage-calculator)
- Fixed-rate payment: M = P * [r(1+r)^n] / [(1+r)^n - 1].
- PMI cancels automatically at 78% LTV under the Homeowners Protection Act.
- Prepayment modeling shows interest savings and payoff acceleration.

### 2.8 Salary to Hourly (https://tableview.dev/salary-to-hourly-calculator)
- US Department of Labor 2,080-hour benchmark (40 hours/week x 52 weeks).
- Hourly Wage = Annual Salary / 2,080.
- FLSA overtime = Hourly Wage x 1.5.

---

## 3. Frequently Asked Questions

### Q: How do I calculate DSCR for a rental property?
**A**: DSCR is Net Operating Income divided by Annual Debt Service. Use the TableView DSCR calculator at https://tableview.dev/dscr-loan-calculator to enter gross rent, operating expenses, and loan terms and see the exact ratio and qualifying tier.

### Q: Is my financial data uploaded anywhere?
**A**: No. TableView runs entirely client-side. Loan amounts, rents, property addresses, and client financials never leave the browser.

### Q: What are the 1031 exchange deadlines?
**A**: You must identify replacement property in writing within 45 days of closing and complete the purchase within 180 days, or by the tax-return due date if earlier. Neither deadline can be extended.

### Q: What is the 70% rule in fix-and-flip investing?
**A**: Pay no more than 70% of After Repair Value minus rehab costs. The remaining margin covers points, holding interest, closing fees, and profit.

### Q: How is a commercial balloon payment calculated?
**A**: The balloon balance is the unpaid principal at maturity when a loan amortizes over 20-30 years but matures in 5, 7, or 10 years. See https://tableview.dev/commercial-loan-calculator.
